newsitem.title: USA: US stock indices soar late, June S&P sets new high.
newsitem.headline: US stock indices soar late, June S&P sets new high.

text.p: U.S. stock index futures rallied sharply in afternoon trade and June Standard and Poor's 500 closed at a new record high.
Traders said a Nasdaq bounce and an onslaught of buying after T-bond futures closed kicked off the rally.

June S&Ps soared through March 11's high of 823.60 and the contract high set February 19 at 827.80, triggering waves of buy-stops at both levels, traders said. Dealers were aggressive buyers as the rally built, with locals also key buyers, traders said.
"The offers were thin," one S&P 500 trader said.
June set a new record at 838.00, up more than 20.00 points from Friday's close.
Traders said the stage for a new record high was set last week when June S&Ps rallied to a more than two-month high.

June posted huge gains on Friday amid a more than 5,000 contract increase in open interest, a combination that several traders said pointed to more gains. They said the open interest increase, along with strong volume, validated Friday's rally and suggested new longs were added on the way up and not just short-covering.
Technicians said Monday's breakout portends more gains.
"The breakout here to new highs could run you well over 870.00 for the June S&P," said Paul Hare, technician with LIT's The Linn Group. "There should be another wave or leg to the upside," he said.
Others agreed, saying June's decisive move through the old high shows acceptance at these record levels.

"Overall the strength of the drive through 827.80 was huge," said Tim Ransford, technician with Dean Witter. "The very high level of acceptance at prices above the old high is indicative that we are going to go higher," Ransford said.
"I'm going to say we're going to push on," he said. He put resistance at 841.00 to 842.00, 844.00 and 855.00 to 857.00.
"We do have some measured targets at 890.00 to 895.00," he added.

At the close, June S&P 500s were up 20.05 pts to 836.60, Value Lines gained 11.25 to 735.00, Nikkei rose 200.0 to 19,890.0, Russell gained 7.65 to 366.50, and NASDAQ rallied 25.0 pts to 942.85. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
